places-chorsu-market-besh-aral-state-nat.story: A 326 km round trip from Tashkent - roughly 5 h 37 in the saddle. The stops in between: The Chatkal State Biosphere Nature Reserve, Besh-Aral State Nature Reserve - main part and back through The Chatkal State Biosphere Nature Reserve.
